  <bpmn:process id="Process_Internship" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Internship">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Internship</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalMerge_ReceiveOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveOffer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept_InvalidateOthers" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invalidate_StatusSplit" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSplit_CandidateUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split" targetRef="Task_CandidateStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSplit_CompanyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Internship" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Internship">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Candidate" name="Candidate">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Internship</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPreferences</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetails_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterExperienceHobbies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetails_Merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OfferDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AcceptOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DenyOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvalidateOtherOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_WeeklyWait</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CandidateStatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_CandidateUpdateCount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StatusUpdates_Join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_InternshipFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRecommendationTweet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RecommendationsSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Internship" name="Begin internship process"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterPreferences" name="Candidate: Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Split" name="Enter experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" name="Candidate: Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Merge" name="Continue to receive offers"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Candidate: Receive an offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept this offer?" default="Flow_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Candidate: Accept offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Candidate: Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Make all other offers invalid"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split" name="Complete status updates"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WeeklyWait" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_WeeklyWait">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P1W</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CandidateStatusUpdate" name="Candidate: Write a status update about the internship">
      <bpmn:documentation>Write at least three status updates, one every week.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CandidateUpdateCount" name="At least 3 candidate updates written?" default="Flow_CandidateUpdates_Continue"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" name="Company: Write a status update about the candidate">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="true">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">3</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Join" name="Status updates complete"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRecommendationTweet" name="Candidate: Send a recommendation tweet to a friend via Twitter">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RecommendationsSent" name="Recommendation tweets sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterPreferences" sourceRef="StartEvent_Internship" targetRef="Task_EnterPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterPreferences_OptionalSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterPreferences" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalSplit_EnterDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Split" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enterAdditionalDetails}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalSplit_SkipDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Split" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterDetails_OptionalMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalMerge_ReceiveOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails_Merge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveOffer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny_ReceiveNextOffer" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept_InvalidateOthers" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invalidate_StatusSplit" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSplit_CandidateUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split" targetRef="Event_WeeklyWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WeeklyWait_CandidateUpdate" sourceRef="Event_WeeklyWait" targetRef="Task_CandidateStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CandidateUpdate_CountCheck" sourceRef="Task_CandidateStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_CandidateUpdateCount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CandidateUpdates_Complete" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateUpdateCount" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Join">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidateUpdateCount >= 3}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CandidateUpdates_Continue" sourceRef="Gateway_CandidateUpdateCount" targetRef="Event_WeeklyWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSplit_CompanyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Split" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyUpdates_StatusJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusJoin_InternshipFinished" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdates_Join" targetRef="Event_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternshipFinished_Tweet" sourceRef="Event_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweet"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet_End" sourceRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweet" targetRef="EndEvent_RecommendationsSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Internship" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Internship">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Candidate" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_InternshipProcess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterPreferences</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterExperienceHobbies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OfferDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AcceptOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DenyOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InvalidateOtherOffers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CandidateStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_InternshipFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRecommendationTweets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_RecommendationsSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InternshipProcess" name="Begin internship process"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterPreferences" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit" name="Enter experience and hobbies?" default="Flow_SkipOptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer as it arrives"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny the offer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept the offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny the offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers immediately upon acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit" name="Write status updates"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CandidateStatusUpdates" name="Write at least 3 weekly status updates about the internship">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${candidateStatusUpdatesWritten < 3}</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" name="Company writes 3 status updates about you">
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
        <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyStatusUpdatesWritten < 3}</bpmn:loopCondition>
      </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRecommendationTweets" name="Send separate tweets recommending the company to friends">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RecommendationsSent" name="Recommendation tweets sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterPreferences" sourceRef="StartEvent_InternshipProcess" targetRef="Task_EnterPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterPreferences_OptionalSplit" sourceRef="Task_EnterPreferences" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterOptionalDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enterExperienceAndHobbies}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipOptionalDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsSplit" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalDetailsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalMerge_ReceiveOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveOffer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerDenied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny_ReceiveNextOffer" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept_InvalidateOtherOffers" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invalidate_StatusUpdatesSplit" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSplit_CandidateUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_CandidateStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusSplit_CompanyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CandidateUpdates_StatusJoin" sourceRef="Task_CandidateStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyUpdates_StatusJoin" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusJoin_InternshipFinished" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin" targetRef="Event_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternshipFinished_SendTweets" sourceRef="Event_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTweets_End" sourceRef="Task_SendRecommendationTweets" targetRef="EndEvent_RecommendationsSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Internship" name="Internship" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Internship">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_InternshipProcess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterTopicAndMoney</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OfferDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AcceptOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DenyOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OtherOffersInvalid</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>SubProcess_Internship</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTweets</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_RecommendationsSent</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_InternshipProcess" name="Begin internship process"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="You enter a topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?" default="Flow_SkipOptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="You enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer as it arrives"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny the offer?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="You accept the offer"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="You deny the offer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateThrowEvent id="Event_OtherOffersInvalid" name="All other offers become invalid"/>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Internship" name="Complete the internship">
      <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_InternshipActivities">
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Intern" name="You">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_InternshipActivities</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_YourStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_InternshipFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
        <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Company" name="Company">
          <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompanyStatusUpdates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        </bpmn:lane>
      </bpmn:laneSet>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_InternshipActivities" name="Internship begins"/>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit" name="Status updates during the internship"/>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_YourStatusUpdates" name="You write at least 3 weekly status updates about your internship">
        <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
          <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${yourStatusUpdatesWritten < 3}</bpmn:loopCondition>
        </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" name="Company writes 3 status updates about you">
        <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
          <bpmn:loopCondition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${companyStatusUpdatesWritten < 3}</bpmn:loopCondition>
        </bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished"/>

      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InternshipStart_Split" sourceRef="Start_InternshipActivities" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_YourUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_YourStatusUpdates"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CompanyUpdates" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesSplit" targetRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_YourUpdates_Join" sourceRef="Task_YourStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CompanyUpdates_Join" sourceRef="Task_CompanyStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_InternshipEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_StatusUpdatesJoin" targetRef="End_InternshipFinished"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweets" name="You send separate tweets via Twitter recommending the company to friends">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${numberOfFriends}</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_RecommendationsSent" name="Recommendation tweets sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterTopicAndMoney" sourceRef="Start_InternshipProcess" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterTopicAndMoney_OptionalDetails" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterOptionalDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${enterExperienceAndHobbies}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipOptionalDetails" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalDetailsToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OptionalMerge_ReceiveOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveOffer_Decision" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerAccepted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerDenied}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deny_ReceiveNextOffer" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accept_OtherOffersInvalid" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Event_OtherOffersInvalid"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherOffersInvalid_Internship" sourceRef="Event_OtherOffersInvalid" targetRef="SubProcess_Internship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Internship_SendTweets" sourceRef="SubProcess_Internship" targetRef="Task_SendTweets"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendTweets_End" sourceRef="Task_SendTweets" targetRef="End_RecommendationsSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
